findings.headline: Replace the babel-preset-solid preset with the @solidjs/babel-plugin plugin.
findings.why: babel-preset-solid compiles JSX for Solid 1. Its Solid 2 successor, @solidjs/babel-plugin 2.0.2, is a Babel plugin, not a preset, so it goes in plugins, and it emits code for @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Remove this preset and add "@solidjs/babel-plugin" to plugins (carry over options such as generate and hydratable; moduleName now defaults to "@solidjs/web"), and swap the package in package.json; migrate swaps the package but not this config. Projects built with @solidjs/vite-plugin don't need a Babel preset for JSX at all.
